create_visualizer_with_backend: create a Visualizer instance with opendr or pytorch3d as the renderer backend for mesh visualization
visualize_with_meshes: call visualize with an input image and a list of predicted mesh dictionaries to render 3D meshes alongside the image
visualize_with_bboxes: call visualize with hand and body bounding box lists to draw detection boxes on the input image
visualize_with_pose: call visualize with a body pose list to draw 2D arm keypoints on the input image
render_predicted_vertices: call the internal render method to overlay 3D mesh vertices and faces onto an image using the configured renderer
